I got the idea from a video about a retired man that was building these in Nebraska and selling citrus. You're basically cutting out shipping/storage costs and probably delivering a better product as your produce won't be picked before it's ripe like they do for a lot of bulk produce.

There are other people building and testing these greenhouses too. It's a pretty appealing plan though as instead of paying to ship produce grown somewhere else in the world you can do it yourself locally and sell direct.

Of course your maximum possible revenue is dependent on the size of the market you're going after. Farmers markets are appealing as you get retail price for your produce and there is little overhead there.
